SELECT 
    BusinessEntityID,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM QuotaDate) AS SalesYear,
    SalesQuota AS CurrentSalesQuota,
    LEAD(SalesQuota, 1, 0) OVER (
        ORDER BY QuotaDate
    ) AS NextYearSalesQuota
FROM Sales.SalesPersonQuotaHistory
WHERE BusinessEntityID = 277
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM QuotaDate) IN (2011, 2012)
ORDER BY QuotaDate;
